correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the one-type to (ideal,filter) bijection with full finite-poset transitivity conditions, the crown Aut group, the 4n mixed bicliques and their two reflection-fixed points, and the transfer T=[[1,1],[1,2]]. A rotation of gcd d has exactly tr(T^d)=L_(2d) invariant ideals (including quotient loops/parallel edges). Three reflection quotient configurations give uT^m v^T, uT^m u^T, vT^(m-1)v^T, each F_(n+3) from T^2=3T-I and initial values. Doubling ideal/filter counts, correcting the common empty type, and applying Burnside proves the full character and orbit formula. The generic-stabilizer estimate uses a union bound and Lucas/Fibonacci exponential growth. Extracted verify.py generated all relevant actual type pairs for n=5,...,9 and checked every group-element fixed set and orbit; it also checked arithmetic through n=50. Finite checks are corroboration, not used to infer the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The invariant is the complete classification of one-point extensions when the isomorphism may permute the finite crown base, rather than named-type counts. The full character distinguishes 2n group elements yet reveals uniform reflection counts across two distinct conjugacy classes, yields an exact integer orbit formula with divisor/Lucas and Fibonacci terms, and quantifies asymptotic rigidity of almost all extensions. This gives a meaningful symmetry classification of a natural homogeneous-poset parameter family; its motivation does not rest on code execution or a numerical tweak.
